store_removed.role: ⭐ THE LAUNDERING CONTROL, on every row: the identical read path with the store's content ablated. ⛔ Not a footnote.

byte_ledger_prototypes.role: request embedding == the kNN arm's ADDRESSING HEAD; the store's own byte count excludes the CLU addressing head by the same convention

addressing_head.role: the CLU arm's request-addressing head (R8); ⛔ excluded from store_bytes

byte_ledger_store.coupling_excluded_reason: ⛔ R26 ruling 3: conditional dreaming is DROPPED as the composition mechanism, and fit_code_coupling/coupling_bytes are referenced only by that landscape. The field is not fitted and not deployed on this path, so its bytes leave the store and the target reverts 688,128 -> 524,288 B.
byte_ledger_store.note: The modes ARE the store. The addressing head is reported separately and is not part of this count; a byte-matched baseline matches store_bytes.

ceiling.note: ⭐ ONE render array read by BOTH instruments, so a gap between them can never be a difference in what they looked at

external_classifier.note: ⭐ ONE instrument for every arm, loaded and hash-asserted; ⛔ not fitted here and ⛔ not of the decoder's lineage

no_bypass.note: The output path has no argument through which encoder information could travel except the K integer codes.

path: request → launch read → codes → THE frozen decoder → image → THE external classifier

checked.statistic: in-corner shape balanced accuracy on REAL held-out images

store.note: ⭐ the CLU arm's probe-space number must reproduce gen-read-compose's row bit-identically

request_only_path.note: ⛔ Neither arm takes a feature tensor. The CLU-wide mixture weights are the softmax of address_requests' per-well log-scores on the REQUEST; gen_store.soft_read (same arithmetic, features as input) is not imported.

rival_regression_check.rule: probe-companion vs the arm's own published probe number, same statistic, same seed; ⛔ never external-vs-probe

row_split.rule: deficit-priority greedy on the pool's own per-factor marginals (target[f][v] = n_val * count_pool[f][v] / n_pool), seeded tie-break
